title: lindernia bracteoides
intro: Lindernia bracteoides, commonly known as False Lipandra, is a plant species belonging to the Linderniaceae family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Lindernia bracteoides involve its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating various infections and diseases. Bioactive constituents present in Lindernia bracteoides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
